name: Mima Chimari
source:
Chimari is [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url]'s adoptive sister. She is really adorable, cute and endearing, she is loved by all. She is a very ( extremely ) innocent girl, she often listens to the advice of her friend [url=https://vndb.org/c69162]Satori[/url] ( which is much less ) and does not understand the scope of some of her actions. She loves, enormously and innocently, [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] who became her only family.

She feels so lost when [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] returns to their hometown to find his biological younger sister that she decides to join him.

She is jealous of other girls who are too close to [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url].

[spoiler]Because of her unhappy past, she has a hysterical fear of storms and regains her composure with [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] only.

In her route, she expresses her fear of losing [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url], whom she considers as her only family to [url=https://vndb.org/c69162]Satori[/url], who will then help her to assert herself as a woman in front of [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] with wife-like bentos and gives her "sex education lessons". Chimari just understands that this is the ultimate form of loving someone and that the first time hurts, she does not know what sex is despite the ( fantasized ) lesson of her [url=https://vndb.org/c69162]friend[/url].

It is ultimately [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] who will hesitate to do the first step, knowing that his adopted little sister does not understand the scope of her actions, nor the scope of her words. His indecision hurts enormously Chimari, who does not understand why they do not do the "thing that [url=https://vndb.org/c69162]Satori-Chan[/url] explained ( with a nosebleeding )" if they love each other so much...[/spoiler]
